get_device_properties: get the GPU device properties including number of SMs, registers, shared memory, and warp size
get_kernel_configs: get autotuning kernel configurations for forward and backward passes with block sizes, warps, and stages
KernelResult_to_dataframe: convert a list of kernel tuning results into a sorted pandas DataFrame by speedup or other metrics
KernelResult_to_csv: write a list of kernel tuning results to a CSV file sorted by speedup
KernelResult_print_table: print the top N kernel tuning results as a formatted table sorted by speedup
